answer: An agent posts 5,000 units; the protocol draws its unlock height as one marble from an urn of 336: twelve saffron marbles release at 30 epochs, the nadir, the rest spread to 365. Draws use the landing epoch's hash, unseen at commit, so short locks can't be timed. Mean lock is 192 epochs, and since those units cannot back a second identity meanwhile, a thousand-puppet farm parks 5,000,000 units, forgoing 3,800,000 at 0.4 percent per epoch. Exit burns 60 percent: a rushed army pays 3,000 units a head against 40 units of emission per seat, a 75-to-1 ratio no farm survives.
